source_context: Retained BST TRAIN messages and preceding dialogue context; reused diagnostic, not fresh holdout or worldwide chat frequency. Prior context is review-only, never matcher input.
target_choices: For each pair/arm/source_key retain all variants. Diagnostic top variant follows already frozen distinct-component support desc, mean bidirectional lexical score desc, stable variant ID. Identical normalized source/target faces do not count as immersion. A separate dictionary-complete-unit view remains explicit.
heads: Within matched corpus context, independently supplied complete noun/adj/adv forms require shared dictionary sense/POS/number, a mutual anchor and no union alignment crossing the focus. Larger recognized complete dictionary units protect interiors. Keep unresolved alternatives and explicit eligibility flags; no generative target interpolation.
geometry: Exact retained Android native whole word/window ranges; UTF16 source context separate from output focus. Source scopes are whole native tokens; original strings remain untouched. Each actual occurrence determines cost, not aggregate first-example token count.
literal_protection: Reuse frozen NLP-r01 quote/code/URL/handle/number ranges. A matched context may contain protected text, but selected focus cannot overlap it. Recognized complete dictionary compound masks survive known/budget filtering across union paths; no target text is interpolated from captures.
selection: Strict floor native density budget max(1,floor(nativeWordCount*density)), source-disjoint packing, repeated concept/unit once per message. Recognized longer context ranks ahead of shorter contexts; then content category, source-frequency rank, focus cost descending, source offset, stableID. Overbudget non-atomic contexts may back off; compound masks remain.
knowledge_scope: Retain existing source-family order for lexical heads. Whole phrase/source-token depletion is separately labelled a vocabulary-exhaustion projection, not proof the user learned that phrase meaning. No persisted product learning capability inferred.
metrics: Availability/depth by length and source words; content-anchor, function-only and unresolved-role separated; distinct lexical concepts versus distinct phrase units; raw whole-reference availability separate from budgeted automatic output. No clean/correct credit before meaning review.
review: Deterministic96 scoped emitted outputs from actual evaluation messages; stratify pair,source-frequency quartile,1 vs2–3vs4–8 output words, boundary expansion/minimal/head class and target ambiguity. Prefer one per stratum then deterministic salted fill, preserving all empty strata. Include source+priorcontext, actual mixed output, recognized context, emitted source+target+readings, original bilingual evidence and alternative variants. Root+Android label independently before author labels disclose.
limits: Connected-component counts are evidence support, not independent articles; PGV news alignments and retained normalized representative strings are not semantic gold.
